integrity: The analytic derivation is included in RESULT.md; finite numerical checks are supporting tests, not a proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Gaussian midwater oxygen partial-pressure deficit and exponential thermal compensation are idealized and not calibrated to observed profiles.
All connectedness statements concern a one-dimensional physiological superlevel set in a finite water column with bottom deeper than deficit centre, not observed species populations.
Generic fold exponents are prior mathematics; priority of the exact model-specific threshold is provisional.
title: A sharp oxygen-refuge fragmentation threshold for a Gaussian midwater deficit
